up: Retrieve IC50 activity measurements for the compound CHEMBL4857685 and all its salt/derivative forms against the target KCNH2 (CHEMBL240). First, look up the molregno of CHEMBL4857685 from molecule_dictionary. Then, using molecule_hierarchy, find all molecules where parent_molregno equals that molregno (include the parent itself where molregno = parent_molregno and any direct children). For each resulting molregno, join activities (on molregno) with assays and target_dictionary to filter for target CHEMBL240 and standard_type = 'IC50'. Return the following columns for each matching activity: the tested molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (pref_name), a relationship indicator (e.g., 'parent' when molregno equals parent_molregno, otherwise 'salt'), the IC50 value (standard_value), units (standard_units), relation operator (standard_relation), pChEMBL value (pchembl_value), and the assay ID (assay_id). Do not impose any additional filters on units, relation, confidence score, or target type. Return all qualifying rows without a row limit.
sql:
WITH parent_mol AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4857685'
),
all_molregnos AS (
  SELECT mh.molregno, mh.parent_molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN parent_mol pm ON mh.parent_molregno = pm.molregno
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  CASE WHEN am.molregno = am.parent_molregno THEN 'parent' ELSE 'salt' END AS relationship,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.pchembl_value,
  a.assay_id
FROM all_molregnos am
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = am.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = am.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL240'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
